title: 第二十三章 日啖牛羊一语破天机第二十四章 逛窑子逛出来的祸事
content_zh:
比岐修为很弱。
他年纪小，筋骨都未彻底长成，还不到锻骨境。
若是被吴青近身，无疑会成为下一个袁骅，而此时的袁骅....尚且生死未卜，不知身在何处。
铁棠心急似火，足下巨力迸发，体内长筋被血气冲击得轰轰作响。
八步赶蝉全力施为！
但这门武学....却并非是纯粹的轻身功法，它实际也是一门腿功。
乃是以双脚尖、双膝、双肘、双手，八个攻击点连续进攻敌人而得名。
单以身法速度而言——并非绝技。
三丈！
二丈！
一丈.....还是慢了。
铁棠看到了吴青背影，仅仅入门的八步赶蝉，如何比得上玉蟾翻浪功。
慌乱的比岐想要后退，却躲不过吴青恐怖的鹰爪。
千钧一发之际。
一只手从比岐身后探出，抓住他的肩膀，往后一丢。
随后又有一只手掌伸了出来，硬接吴青碧髓玉化的大力鹰爪功。
这只手掌五指根根肿涨如胡萝卜，却是被浑厚血气充盈所致，如同翻天印压盖下来。
轰隆！
山野密林惊起巨响，远处有凶兽咆哮回应。
前方攻势被挡，后有劲风来袭。

吴青想都不想，猛地一蹲，四肢着地，如同一个大蛤蟆，反身一跃，蹦出了包围圈。
“多谢段县捕相助！”
赶来的铁棠，看到了何人出手。
“险些让旧事重演。”段景瑞甩了甩右手，上面五个红点清晰可见，几近发黑。
单论双手上的造诣，他自是不如吴青的大力鹰爪功。
铁棠转过身来，看着近乎贴附地面的吴青。
“你还要负隅顽抗吗？”
“事已至此，总捕头多说无益，漫说两人，便是千人万人，我也不会投降。”
“那你先前....为何要故意被我擒住？”
以吴青现在展示的修为实力，先前在运城当中，仅是易筋大成的铁棠，不可能拿下他。
他之所被擒，显然是故意的。
吴青不答。
段景瑞也一言不发，暗暗观察此处战场，从四下的搏斗痕迹，以及如今双方鼓动的蒸腾气血，他判断出了双方的修为。
“总捕头修为怎么又提升了？易筋大圆满.....太快太快了，怎么做到的？
而且。
易筋大圆满，又是如何与洗髓大成僵持这么久？”
场面一时陷入了古怪的寂静当中，铁棠碍于段景瑞的不明身份，也不敢贸然与他联手，擒拿吴青。
而吴青巴不得不动手，正在寻找遁逃的机会。
唰！唰！
第四方势力出现，打破了僵局。

刑堂林堂主、缉捕堂堂主二人从密林中接连冒头。
content_en:
Biqi's cultivation is very weak.
He is young, his muscles and bones have not fully grown, and he has not yet reached the bone forging stage.
If Wu Qing gets close to him, he will undoubtedly become the next Yuan Hua, and at this time, Yuan Hua... is still uncertain whether he is alive or dead, and where he is.
Tie Tang's heart was so anxious that he burst out with great force, and the long tendons in his body roared as the blood and energy hit him.
Eight steps to catch up the cicada and do your best!
But this martial arts... is not a pure light body technique, it is actually a leg technique.
It gets its name from its eight attack points of toes, knees, elbows, and hands, which are used to continuously attack the enemy.
In terms of body speed alone - it is not a unique skill.
Three feet!
Two feet!
One foot...still too slow.
Tie Tang saw Wu Qing's back. How could he compare to Yu Chan's wave-turning skill with just eight steps to catch a cicada?
The panicked Bi Qi wanted to retreat, but could not avoid Wu Qing's terrifying eagle claws.
At the critical moment.
A hand reached out from behind Biqi, grabbed his shoulder, and threw him back.
Then another palm stretched out and took Wu Qing Jade Jade's powerful Eagle Claw Skill.
The five fingers of this palm are swollen and swollen like a carrot, but they are caused by the thick blood filling them, like a heaven-shaking seal pressed down.
Boom!
There was a loud noise in the dense forest, and a ferocious beast roared in response in the distance.
The forward attack was blocked, and a strong wind came from behind.
Wu Qing didn't even think about it. He crouched down suddenly and landed on all fours. Like a big toad, he jumped out of the encirclement.
"Thank you Duan County for your help!"
Tie Tang came and saw who took action.
"Almost made the past happen again." Duan Jingrui shook his right hand, and the five red dots on it were clearly visible, almost turning black.
In terms of achievements in both hands alone, he is not as good as Wu Qing's powerful eagle claw skill.
Tie Tang turned around and looked at Wu Qing, who was almost touching the ground.
"Are you still going to resist?"
"The matter is now at this point. It is useless to talk too much about arresting the head. Talking about two people, even if there are thousands of people, I will not surrender."
"Then... why did you deliberately capture me before?"
With Wu Qing's current display of cultivation strength, it was impossible for Tie Tang, who was only a master of Yi Jin in Yuncheng, to defeat him.
His capture was obviously intentional.
Wu Qing didn't answer.
Duan Jingrui also said nothing and secretly observed the battlefield here. From the traces of fighting all around and the steaming energy and blood now being stirred up by both sides, he judged the cultivation levels of both sides.
"How come the chief catcher's cultivation has improved again? Yi Jin Dzogchen... it's too fast, too fast, how did you do it?
And.
How come Yi Jin Dzogchen has been in a stalemate with Marrow Cleansing Dacheng for so long? "
The scene fell into a strange silence for a moment. Due to Duan Jingrui's unknown identity, Tie Tang did not dare to join forces with him rashly to capture Wu Qing.
Wu Qingba had no choice but to take action and was looking for an opportunity to escape.
Uh-huh! Uh-huh!
A fourth force emerged and broke the deadlock.
Hall Master Lin of the Punishment Hall and Hall Master of the Arrest Hall emerged one after another from the dense forest.
